title: Local pi-durable workers only run inside the ticfac repo: the harness is found at <repo>/harness
description: internal/exec/subprocess/executor.go harnessDir() defaults to filepath.Join(e.repo, "harness") unless TICFAC_HARNESS_DIR is set, and the runner launches node --import {{harness_dir}}/runtime/register.mjs {{harness_dir}}/src/local/main.ts. In any other repository (or on a machine with only the released binaries, e.g. ralph) there is no harness/ dir and no node_modules, so a local run on the pi-durable harness cannot start a worker. Ship the harness with the release (embedded and extracted to a versioned cache dir with its deps, or a release asset installed beside the binaries), resolve it from there by default, and have ticfac doctor check it. Found 2026-10-07 setting ticfac up on a second machine (ralph).
acceptance_criteria: a local pi-durable run in a repo that is not ticfac, on a machine with only the installed release, dispatches and completes a worker; doctor names a missing harness; tests cover the resolution; make gate passes
